title.en: Watercolor anime fetish montage rapid cuts

description.en: Controls a vertical watercolor anime fetish montage of rapid macro body details interleaved with symbolic temperature-and-heartbeat b-roll.

project:

  rule: "直接的な性的表現は避け、心拍・温度・湿度・緊張を伝える"
